design_notes: Professional, data-driven aesthetic with a security/intelligence theme. Use a dark-on-light color scheme (white/light gray background, dark text) with vibrant accent colors for data visualization. Implement responsive design with clear section hierarchy, card-based layout, and print-friendly A4 formatting. Emphasize clarity and readability over decorative elements. Utilize charts, heatmaps, progress bars, and timeline markers for data representation. Ensure all visual elements support rapid comprehension of complex information for senior law enforcement personnel.
